The Manulife Bank Visa Infinite* Card is built to reward the things you love, the way you live, and the healthy choices you make every day. When you invest in your health by paying for your gym membership, attending a dentist appointment, or picking up a new pair of running shoes, you’ll automatically earn valuable Manulife Better Rewards™. And when you stay connected to the people you care about — over coffee, at the theatre or on a weekend away—you can continue earning rewards with access to travel protection and Visa Infinite benefits along the way!

At a glance :

  • 2% rewards on health and wellness; 1.5% rewards on travel, dining and entertainment; 1% rewards on everyday essentials4
  • Extensive travel medical coverage, including 20 days of coverage for travellers under 65 and 7 days for travellers aged 65 and over5
  • Plus, coverage for trip interruption, flight delay, travel accident, baggage loss and delay, rental vehicle damage, purchase protection and extended warranty5
  • Visa Infinite benefits6 — Luxury Hotel Collection, RSVP RewardsTM, Concierge Service, Dining Series, Wine Country Program, and Access® Golf Benefit

Wellness, health and medical purchases include a long list of items and services that can help support your well-being. Examples include:

  • Membership Clubs (Sports, Recreation, Gym)
  • Drugstore/pharmacy purchases
  • Hearing aids, orthopedics, vision care
  • Optometrists, optical goods, opticians and more 
  • Treatments from a registered therapist (massage, chiropractic, physio)
  • Fitness, mental wellness and nutrition apps subscriptions

Note : Please refer to Cardholder Agreement for complete details

You can redeem your rewards anytime towards an eligible purchase or statement credit as long as the account is in good standing.

Note : Rewards cannot be used towards your minimum monthly payment.

Rewards are shown as points on your monthly statement. Points are calculated by multiplying the Net Purchase value by the Reward rate for the category, then multiplying the result by 100.

For example, a Net Purchase of $1,000 in the 1% Rewards category is calculated as follows: $1,000 x 1% x 100 = 1,000 points. Points calculations are rounded to the nearest whole point.

InsuranceWhat’s included5
Emergency Medical InsuranceTravel with protection, whether you charged the trip to your card or not. You, your spouse and dependent children are automatically insured for eligible emergency medical and dental expenses. 
Rental Vehicle DamageBenefit from added protection when you rent a vehicle. Charge the full cost of your car rental to your Manulife Bank Visa Infinite Card and receive Rental Vehicle Damage Insurance Coverage
Flight & Baggage DelayTake the stress out of delays. Charge your scheduled flight to your Manulife Bank Visa Infinite Card and receive coverage for expenses related to meals, accommodation and more when your flight is delayed, or your checked baggage is delayed, lost or damaged
Trip InterruptionIf your trip is interrupted due to an illness or injury, you can be protected. You, your spouse and your dependent children automatically have Trip Interruption Insurance for trips charged to your Manulife Bank Visa Infinite Card.
Purchase Protection and Extended WarrantyRun into a problem with a purchase made with the card or concerned about the warranty? We’re here to help. Enjoy Purchase Protection and Extended Warranty on most new purchases made with your new card.
Travel AccidentYou, your spouse and dependent children may be covered for up to $500,000 (Cdn) when you use your Manulife Bank Visa Infinite Card to book your trip on a common carrier, such as plane, ship or train.

Please refer to the Certificates of Insurance included with your Cardholder Agreement for complete coverage details.

1 You will earn 10% rewards on the first $2,000 in net eligible purchases when those purchases are posted to your account beginning on your account opening date and ending three statements after your account opening date.  You will earn a bonus of an additional 8% rewards, for a total of 10% rewards at merchants classified by Visa Inc. and determined by Manulife Bank to be in the Health, Wellness & Medical Category, when those purchases are posted to your account beginning on your account opening date and ending three statements after your account opening date. You will earn a bonus of an additional 8.5% rewards, for a total of 10% rewards on purchases at merchants classified by Visa Inc. and determined by Manulife Bank to be in the Travel, Dining and Entertainment categories, when those purchases are posted to your account beginning on your account opening date and ending three statements after your account opening date. You will earn a bonus of an additional 9% rewards, for a total of 10% rewards on purchases at merchants not falling within the Health, Wellness, Medical, Travel, Dining or Entertainment categories when those purchases are posted to your account beginning on your account opening date and ending three statements after your account opening date.  Purchases may take a few days or more to post to your account depending on the merchant. Purchases made but not yet posted within the three statement offer period are not eligible for the bonus. You will earn the standard rewards rates outlined in your Rewards Terms and Conditions once you reach the $2,000 promotional spending limit or after the three statement offer period, whichever comes first. All other terms of the Manulife Bank Rewards Terms and Conditions that apply to your account continue to apply during this promotional offer. This offer may be changed, terminated or suspended, in whole or part, at any time and cannot be combined with any other offer unless otherwise stated.

2 Your annual card fee of $139 will be waived in the first year only based on your account opening date. An annual fee of $50 for each additional user will still apply.

3 Only the Primary Cardholder may request a balance transfer. The promotional 1.99% annual interest rate (AIR) applies to any credit card balance transfer the client makes within 90 days of their account opening date, and will remain in effect for 180 days (6 months) from the transfer date. After the promotional period, the 1.99% rate on any promotional balances (including balances that remain unpaid after the offer ends) will increase to the regular interest rate for balance transfers. Interest applies from the date a transfer(s) is posted to the new Manulife Bank Credit Card Account. Balance transfers are subject to credit availability, must be repaid, and are administered according to the terms of the Cardholder Agreement. Your payments will be applied in accordance with the Application of Payments section indicated in your Cardholder Agreement. For greater clarity, if you pay more than the Minimum Payment, the payment would be applied proportionately across all categories making up the total balance including Balance Transfer balances at their promotional interest rate. For example, after your Minimum Payment is made, if your Purchases category had a balance of $300 and you have a Balance Transfer balance of $100 at a promotional rate for a total balance owing of $400, a $300 payment will be applied as follows: $225 will be applied to your Purchases category (75% x $300); and $75 will be applied to Balance Transfer category at the promotional rate (25% x $300). Balances transferred may only be used to pay a balance on a Canadian financial institution issued consumer credit card account that Manulife Bank approves. Balance transfers will be fulfilled in the order (the client/you) requested them and in accordance with the Cardholder Agreement. The total value of balance transfers cannot exceed the authorized credit limit on the credit card account. If the total value is greater, Manulife Bank may have to send only a partial payment to the last designated account / named creditor. A fee of 3% of the balance transfer amount will be charged to your account when the balance transfer amount is posted to your account. If you do not pay off your amount due in full by the due date, interest will be charged on the fee at the regular annual interest rate for purchases from the date the fee is posted to your account. This offer cannot be used to transfer a balance from another Manulife account, or to make a payment or deposit to another Manulife account. No rewards will be earned on the balance transfer. Offer may be changed or extended at any time.

4 You will earn 2% rewards on the first $25,000 you spend annually on health, wellness and medical purchases. You will earn 1.5% rewards on the first $25,000 you spend annually on travel, entertainment and dining. All other purchases earn 1%. The $25,000 annual spending limits will reset to zero on each anniversary of the date you opened your credit card account. Terms, conditions and eligible merchant/merchant categories may change without notice. Rewards are earned on card purchases less returns and not on cash advances, interest, fees, service/transaction charges, balance transfers and payments.

5 Insurance is subject to exclusions, limitations, and conditions. Clients should refer to the Certificates of Insurance included with their Cardholder Agreement for complete details on each benefit. Clients should read the Certificates of Insurance then keep the Cardholder Agreement in a safe place with other valuable documents and take it with them when they travel.
